description: The daily path had nothing telling the team which world dev points at — safety depended on memory (the exact thing this whole effort kills), while the rare path (prod-run) already taught well. Three layers make the TOOLS say where you are, read from the REAL env on disk (never a doc/memory/marker): L1 mode-banner.mjs runs as fe's `predev` so every `npm run dev` prints a FIRST line before boot — 🟢 practice (localhost) / 🔴 remote-not-practice (host FAMILY only, never claims 'production' since a supabase host may be prod or the paused dev project — status makes the finer call) / ⚪ unknown → STOP (exit non-zero → npm aborts dev; can't-verify != safe). L2 guard.sh, on refuse, now TEACHES: why-stopped / how-to-proceed (BOTH paths: normal `stack.sh up` + intentional `prod-run`) / where-to-read, and its per-key REFUSE lines are masked to host FAMILY only (no full host/creds). L3 `stack.sh status` (new, READ-ONLY) answers 4 from real state not markers: where each app points (practice/prod/dev/neon/unknown via classify_db — matching the ฟีม-confirmed topology soxsc=PROD/jgxsj=DEV/Neon=backup, reading DB host + username since the project ref lives in the username for the DB_* shape), docker up?, outbound pipe blocked?, leftover residue (shadow/marker). Scope: fe only (be needs ฟีม approval per 'notify before touching BE'; bazi needs branch pdf-dev — both deferred). L1 touches ONLY the package.json dev-script line, no app logic. Teeth (real machine): banner 🔴 on real fe (family only), 🟢 on local, ⚪+exit1 on no-DATABASE_URL AND on an unrecognized host (neg-control: unknown → STOP, never assume safe); `npm run dev` with white → next dev never started (:3000 not opened); guard teaching block shows both paths with 0 leaked host/cred strings + guard.test 18/18 still green; status classifies fe/be→dev bazi→neon, proven read-only (env shas + git unchanged before/after), classify_db unit (no-DB→unknown, localhost→practice, weird-host→unknown). Never prints an env value anywhere. Review rounds hardened it: banner leads 'ไม่ใช่สนามซ้อม' (never overclaims prod — a supabase host may be prod or paused-dev; status makes the finer call reading the project ref) + exact-match local (LOCAL.includes, not startsWith — closes a fail-open). L3 classify_one: the first cut was a 3-part fail-OPEN (`*localhost*` matched anywhere, classified a CONCAT of keys, practice-before-prod) so a prod string merely CONTAINING 'localhost' could show green — redesigned to strip comments, check remote/ref FIRST (false match errs remote not green), call practice ONLY on an EXTRACTED host that is EXACTLY local, classify EACH connection value separately (never concat across keys), and REPORT a mismatch (⚠️ คีย์ DB ชี้คนละที่) when DB keys disagree rather than pick the best-looking; NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is a fallback-only (no DB key), never folded into the DB verdict. Guard refuse message reworded off 'production' → 'ไม่ใช่สนามซ้อม' + points to status (it too sees only the family). Sibling sweep (บอง: we fixed startsWith→includes in the banner but must check its kin, like #167/#176): re-audited banner (exact+single-value), guard (fail-closed+exact), status (fixed) — no loose-match fail-open remains in any of the three. gate_layer=infra/tooling + human-awareness. Real metric = the มุน cold-use test (do NOT pre-brief her).
